title: Uniform ZeroSlack closure and contradiction
purpose: Discharge UFS-005 by binding the ZeroSlack contradiction, selector universe, HN/BUD blocker closure, and no-lower ledger into one uniform all-rank proof surface.

zeroSlackClosure.domain: Every normalized locked NAND instance whose threshold surface and residual-band minimizer surface were accepted by UFS-003 and UFS-004.
zeroSlackClosure.conclusion: If PCCOracle returns ZeroSlack(C,Z), then Lambda(C)=0; if Lambda(C)>0 then the no-lower ledger plus BCEL/packet/selector/realizer/HB closure yields a contradiction.
zeroSlackClosure.rankMeasure: finite packet rank tuple ordered lexicographically by packet kind, span, mass class, colour class, frontier class, charge class, budget class, hereditary class, activation class, rank tag, and canonical code
zeroSlackClosure.polynomialSizeBound: O(poly(encoded locked NAND instance)) under schedule-bounded handles, selector payloads, sidecars, blocker edges, and rank ledgers

proofObligations.statement: The ZeroSlack branch positively excludes HResolve minimum/gain, BudgetResolve minimum/gain, normalization gain, named obstruction, exact route, selector descent, strict residual descent, saturation loss, packet route failure, and lower-priority replay route.
If Lambda(C)>0 and no earlier route fires, terminal MuBridge, SaturatePositive, and BCELReady yield a saturated projection-positive BCEL nucleus.
BN2 through BN6 and packet extraction convert every BCEL positive nucleus into a pair, balanced-triple, or full-span faithful selector in a polynomial selector universe.
Every realizer bot for a faithful selector is typed and can cite only an HN blocker, BUD blocker, or lower-rank faithful selector.
The combined HN/BUD blocker graph strictly descends in the accepted rank and tie-break measure, so no circular negative closure is possible.
Selector silence and HB closure exclude faithful selectors, HN blockers, and BUD blockers at every packet rank in the ZeroSlack branch.
Assuming Lambda(C)>0 forces a BCEL nucleus, a positive packet, a faithful selector, and then either a verified gain or an impossible typed bot; therefore Lambda(C)=0.
The ZeroSlack record, sidecars, rank lists, selector logs, blocker edges, packet ledgers, and contradiction proof nodes have polynomial-size canonical encodings.

nonClaims: This checker discharges only UFS-005 ZeroSlackContradictionUniform.
This checker does not by itself prove SAT in P or P = NP.
This checker does not clear Release.UnrestrictedFinalSoundness.
This checker does not use external review as a mathematical premise.
